summary: The XL Ankh3 model; the largest Ankh3 variant, with 2560-dim embeddings, trained with the same multi-task denoising + sequence-completion recipe.
architecture: T5-style encoder–decoder (Ankh line); 2560-dim per-residue encoder embeddings; task-prefix conditioning for representation vs. generation.
pretraining_objective: Multi-task: masked language modeling at multiple masking probabilities plus protein sequence completion (sequence-only).
key_innovations: Largest Ankh3 variant; highest embedding dimension (2560) in this benchmark's Ankh line
Multi-task sequence-only pretraining aimed at richer, more generalizable representations
when_to_use: When maximum Ankh3 capacity / high-dimensional embeddings are desired and the extra compute is acceptable.
caveats: Very recent (2025); parameter counts and full training details are not clearly published; verify before quoting. High embedding dim increases downstream head cost.

citations.title: Ankh3: Multi-Task Pretraining with Sequence Denoising and Completion Enhances Protein Representations
